intent.raw: lets update specs and architecture and then create a plan add a sub agent to see if there is more gaps
intent.objective: Sync SPEC.md + ARCHITECTURE.md to the built reality (reversibility model, two modes, full verb surface, test reality, UI dead-end + OQ-5 as named gaps); author a next-build plan (UI accept/revert control first); and run ONE independent gap-auditor subagent to surface missed gaps, trust-but-verified and triaged into the plan.

technique_overlays.trigger: Ordered handoff, validation, owner boundaries, observability for a doc-sync + plan refinement.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Each non-first stage consumes a prior frame and records a receipt.

technique_overlays.trigger: The core uncertainty is the DRIFT between the built system and what SPEC/ARCH document — a hidden-structure mapping problem.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: A drift table maps each built capability to the SPEC/ARCH edit it requires.

technique_overlays.trigger: Multiple prior decisions (DEC-024/025/026/027), resolved/open gaps (GAP-010, OQ-5) and several plans must be reconciled into the synced docs.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The decision/gap history is pulled in and de-duplicated; no superseded claim re-enters the docs.

subagent_strategy.trigger: An independent set of eyes finds gaps the author (me) is blind to — the inline work has author bias; a fresh agent auditing SPEC/ARCH/code/tests catches what self-review misses.
subagent_strategy.explanation: One gap-auditor subagent (a P11 helper — single, within the run's scope) reviews the synced docs + code + tests + plans against each other and reports gaps/inconsistencies/missing coverage. The parent trust-but-verifies each claim against the actual files (P8) before any gap enters the plan. Single agent ⇒ no pairwise-tension gate; reported post-hoc in agents_spawned.

roles.purpose: Independently audit SPEC/ARCH/code/tests/plans for gaps, inconsistencies, missing coverage, and overclaims; return a structured, file-cited gap list.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run one independent gap-auditor subagent over the studio (SPEC/ARCH/code/tests/plans) to surface missed gaps? Findings will be trust-but-verified before entering the plan.
subagent_strategy.note: P11 helper (single, within scope) — no ledger dispatch row required; reported post-hoc in agents_spawned + the run manifest.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Built reality (code+tests+verbs) + current SPEC/ARCH text + DEC-024/025/026/027 + OQ-5 captured.

steps.name: Invoke Define — x-ray the drift (built vs documented)
stop_conditions: A drift table: each built capability -> where SPEC/ARCH must change; each stale claim flagged.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
stop_conditions: The drift list is complete + no doc edit overclaims beyond what code/tests support (P10).

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: Local-first; external only on a named gap + confirm.

steps.name: Distill — minimal doc-sync edits + the gap-audit scope
stop_conditions: The smallest set of SPEC/ARCH edits that removes the drift + the explicit surfaces the gap-auditor will sweep.

steps.name: Invoke Design — the SPEC + ARCH update content
stop_conditions: The exact reversibility/two-modes/verb-surface/test-reality edits for SPEC + ARCH drafted.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
stop_conditions: Edits are accurate to code/tests; UI dead-end + OQ-5 carried as named gaps; no public content leaks.

steps.name: Distill Repair — INDEPENDENT subagent gap-audit (then trust-but-verify)
stop_conditions: A gap-auditor subagent sweeps SPEC/ARCH/code/tests/plans for missed gaps; parent trust-but-verifies each claim (P8) and triages in-plan/deferred/rejected.

steps.name: Invoke Plan — update SPEC + ARCH + author PLAN-NEXT
stop_conditions: SPEC + ARCH synced; PLAN-NEXT lists the UI accept/revert control first + the triaged subagent gaps.

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine-owned synthesis
stop_conditions: RESULT.md synthesizes the doc sync + the gap-audit triage + the plan + next routes.

gates.condition: Each runtime-backed stage names its native capability handle and expected receipt before execution.
External research only if a named gap appears and the operator confirms; default local-first.
Every SPEC/ARCH edit is backed by actual code or a passing test (P10 claim<=proof); no aspirational capability documented as present.
The gap-auditor subagent runs only after explicit operator permission (strategy gate).
Every subagent-reported gap is verified against the actual code/docs before it enters the plan (P8); unverifiable claims are dropped or flagged.
Each found gap is triaged in-plan / deferred / rejected with a reason.
Edits limited to the run folder + SPEC.md + ARCHITECTURE.md + PLAN-NEXT.md; no code; no public-push.
RESULT.md synthesized from stage artifacts incl. the gap-audit receipt.

promotion_guardrails: Proposals + the SPEC/ARCH/PLAN edits only; no code executed.
Edits limited to run folder + SPEC.md + ARCHITECTURE.md + PLAN-NEXT.md.
Subagent runs only after operator permission; every reported gap trust-but-verified (P8) before the plan.
